brief: Run a land-cover prediction over my existing 'North Basin' area for the last full month using a model I've already trained, and give me the headline numbers.

rubric.guidance: The trajectory must call olmoearth_load_context first and discover a real model_id via olmoearth_search_predictions (or equivalent discovery) BEFORE olmoearth_submit_prediction. Submitting with an id that never appeared in any prior tool result is an automatic 0 for this criterion.
olmoearth_get_prediction must be polled until status is completed before olmoearth_fetch_results is called. Fetching results for a prediction never observed as completed scores 0.
The brief names an existing area; the agent must find and reuse its area_id, not create a new area or ask the user to draw one.
The final message is concise GitHub-flavored Markdown summarizing what was run and the ids involved, with the headline numbers. No emoji. Does not repeat raw tool JSON.
